leads.title: Ceará State General Attorney Decision 02/2013
leads.documents: Obligates all notaries statewide to accept same-sex marriages, establishing same-sex marriage in Ceará
leads.detail: Ruled 7 March 2013 by Francisco Sales Neto; took effect 15 March 2013; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Ceará law on police training - signed by Governor Lúcio Alcântara
leads.documents: Mandates inclusion of educational materials on sexual orientation in training of the state's Civil and Military Police
leads.detail: Signed 16 November 2006; published in the Official Gazette on the 26th; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling on homophobia/transphobia
leads.documents: Rules discrimination on basis of sexual orientation and gender identity is a crime akin to racism
leads.detail: Ruled 13 June 2019; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Ceará Law No. 17,480
leads.documents: Establishes mandatory installation of notices against discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity in establishments
leads.detail: Signed 19 May 2021 by Governor Camilo Santana (PT); no URL visible in text

leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling on gender identity
leads.documents: Rules transgender person has right to change official name and sex by self-declaration without surgery or professional evaluation
leads.detail: Ruled 1 March 2018; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Court of Justice of Ceará (TJCE) decision on Brune Bonassi
leads.documents: Authorized rectification of documents to reflect neutral gender, first non-binary person in Ceará to do so
leads.detail: Decided 22 May 2024; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Sobral City Council bill on gender issues in schools
leads.documents: Approved bill to ban teaching of gender issues in city schools, vetoed by Mayor Ivo Gomes with veto upheld
leads.detail: City Council approval 12 December 2017; no URL visible in text
